turns.query: Using the HK_population_1km grid (datasets/HK_population_1km.csv; each row is a grid cell with a longitude/latitude point and a population count), compute the total population of all grid cells whose point (its longitude/latitude, SRID 4326) falls INSIDE any land_use_zone polygon of land_category 'Conservation'. Return the total population, rounded to the nearest integer.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Entity resolution for the named land-use category: Conservation
land_category_name_conservation = "Conservation"
land_category_id_conservation = None  # category is an enum value, not an id-bearing entity

exact_category_check_sql = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM land_use_zone
WHERE land_category::text = :cat
""")
exact_category_n = int(pd.read_sql(exact_category_check_sql, engine, params={"cat": land_category_name_conservation}).iloc[0]["n"])

if exact_category_n > 0:
    land_category_conservation = land_category_name_conservation
    print(f"RESOLVED: {land_category_name_conservation} = {land_category_conservation}")
else:
    fuzzy_category_check_sql = text("""
    SELECT land_category::text AS category, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM land_use_zone
    WHERE land_category::text ILIKE :pattern
    GROUP BY land_category::text
    ORDER BY n DESC
    LIMIT 1
    """)
    fuzzy_category_df = pd.read_sql(fuzzy_category_check_sql, engine, params={"pattern": f"%{land_category_name_conservation}%"})
    if len(fuzzy_category_df) > 0:
        land_category_conservation = str(fuzzy_category_df.iloc[0]["category"])
        print(f"RESOLVED: {land_category_name_conservation} = {land_category_conservation}")
    else:
        land_category_conservation = None
        print(f"UNRESOLVED: {land_category_name_conservation}")

# Stage population grid data by reusing authoritative shared-runtime DataFrame; do not overwrite pop_df
population_grid_1km_df_for_conservation = pop_df
required_population_cols = {"longitude", "latitude", "population"}
population_grid_has_required_fields = required_population_cols.issubset(set(population_grid_1km_df_for_conservation.columns))
print(f"population_grid_1km_df_for_conservation row count: {len(population_grid_1km_df_for_conservation)}")
print(f"population_grid_1km_df_for_conservation required fields present: {population_grid_has_required_fields}")

# Fetch Conservation land-use polygons, ensuring geometries are SRID 4326
if land_category_conservation is not None:
    conservation_luz_count_sql = text("""
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ST_SRID(geometry) = 4326) AS srid_4326_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ST_SRID(geometry) <> 4326) AS non_4326_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE geometry IS NULL) AS null_geometry_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(area), 0) AS recorded_area_sum_sqm
    FROM land_use_zone
    WHERE land_category::text = :cat
    """)
    conservation_luz_summary_df = pd.read_sql(conservation_luz_count_sql, engine, params={"cat": land_category_conservation})
    conservation_luz_expected_rows = int(conservation_luz_summary_df.iloc[0]["row_count"])
    print(f"conservation_luz_summary_df row count: {len(conservation_luz_summary_df)}")
    print(
        "Conservation land-use polygon summary: "
        f"features={conservation_luz_expected_rows}, "
        f"srid_4326={int(conservation_luz_summary_df.iloc[0]['srid_4326_count'])}, "
        f"non_4326={int(conservation_luz_summary_df.iloc[0]['non_4326_count'])}, "
        f"null_geometries={int(conservation_luz_summary_df.iloc[0]['null_geometry_count'])}, "
        f"recorded_area_sum_sqm={float(conservation_luz_summary_df.iloc[0]['recorded_area_sum_sqm'])}"
    )

    if conservation_luz_expected_rows == 0:
        recheck_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
        SELECT land_category::text AS category, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM land_use_zone
        WHERE land_category::text ILIKE '%conserv%'
        GROUP BY land_category::text
        ORDER BY n DESC
        LIMIT 10
        """), engine)
        print(f"Conservation fetch EMPTY after resolved category; recheck candidate category count: {len(recheck_df)}")
        conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df = pd.DataFrame()
    else:
        conservation_luz_fetch_sql = text("""
        SELECT
            id,
            zone_label,
            land_category::text AS land_category,
            specified_use,
            description,
            area,
            ST_SRID(ST_Transform(geometry, 4326)) AS geometry_srid,
            ST_AsEWKB(ST_Transform(geometry, 4326)) AS geometry_ewkb
        FROM land_use_zone
        WHERE land_category::text = :cat
        """)
        conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df = pd.read_sql(conservation_luz_fetch_sql, engine, params={"cat": land_category_conservation})
        print(f"conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df row count: {len(conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df)}")
        print(
            "Fetched Conservation geometry SRID confirmation: "
            f"all_4326={bool((conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df['geometry_srid'] == 4326).all())}, "
            f"unique_srid_count={conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df['geometry_srid'].nunique()}"
        )
else:
    conservation_luz_summary_df = pd.DataFrame()
    conservation_land_use_zone_polygons_4326_df = pd.DataFrame()
    print("Conservation land-use polygons not fetched because category was unresolved.")

# Domain knowledge staged for interpretation
population_grid_domain_note = "Population grid cells are represented by longitude/latitude point coordinates; spatial inclusion should test each cell point against Conservation land-use polygons."
land_use_geometry_domain_note = "Land-use-zone geometries are statutory planning-zone MultiPolygons; fetched Conservation geometries are confirmed/staged in EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude coordinates."
print("Domain notes staged: population point-in-polygon interpretation; Conservation land-use geometries in SRID 4326.")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

old_conservation_pop = conservation_pop

# Fresh independent recomputation: load/validate the population grid and test each point against Conservation polygons in the database.
pop_source = pop_df[['longitude', 'latitude', 'population']].copy()
pop_source = pop_source.dropna(subset=['longitude', 'latitude', 'population'])
pop_source['gid'] = range(len(pop_source))

with engine.begin() as conn:
    cat_summary = pd.read_sql(text("""
        SELECT land_category::text AS category, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(area),0) AS area_sum
        FROM land_use_zone
        WHERE land_category = 'Conservation'
        GROUP BY land_category
    """), conn)

    conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_verify_population_grid"))
    conn.execute(text("""
        CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_verify_population_grid (
            gid integer,
            longitude double precision,
            latitude double precision,
            population double precision
        ) ON COMMIT DROP
    """))
    pop_source.to_sql("temp_verify_population_grid", conn, if_exists="append", index=False, method="multi", chunksize=1000)

    agg = pd.read_sql(text("""
        WITH matched AS (
            SELECT p.gid, p.population
            FROM temp_verify_population_grid p
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM land_use_zone z
                WHERE z.land_category = 'Conservation'
                  AND ST_Contains(
                      z.geometry,
                      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.longitude, p.latitude), 4326)
                  )
            )
        )
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM temp_verify_population_grid) AS total_grid_cells,
            COUNT(*) AS inside_grid_cells,
            COALESCE(SUM(population), 0) AS inside_population_unrounded,
            ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(population), 0))::bigint AS inside_population_rounded
        FROM matched
    """), conn)

independent_conservation_pop = int(agg.loc[0, 'inside_population_rounded'])
conservation_pop = independent_conservation_pop

print("Conservation category polygon count:", int(cat_summary['n'].iloc[0]) if len(cat_summary) else 0)
print("Population grid cells checked:", int(agg.loc[0, 'total_grid_cells']))
print("Population grid cells inside Conservation polygons:", int(agg.loc[0, 'inside_grid_cells']))
print("Unrounded Conservation population:", float(agg.loc[0, 'inside_population_unrounded']))
print(f"VERIFY conservation_pop: stored={old_conservation_pop} | independent={independent_conservation_pop} | final={conservation_pop}")
print("conservation_pop =", conservation_pop)
